Bernoulli sponsorship entails the following three stipulations: Displaying the Bernoulli logo in all publicity material, including webpages, posters, flyers, etc. Appointing a Bernoulli Society member to serve on the programme committee, who will ensure that the meeting is announced in Bernoulli News as a Bernoulli-sponsored event and who will provide a brief post-meeting report for Bernoulli News . Offering a reduced registration fee for Bernoulli Society members, unless a flat fee applies to all participants.
